snippet.title: Papercraft Tactics - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Papercraft Tactics - Gameplay Trailer
Arrange a living backpack of swords, potions, and trinkets to auto‑battle foes in a paper‑theater roguelike. Link items to trigger chain reactions, play tactical cards, and outsmart bosses run after run.

Steam : Papercraft Tactics
